**Sources**

- [Norman 1983] K. R. Norman, Pali Literature (1983) / History of Indian Literature — Details on the Pātimokkha opening exhortation, the Old Commentary, Buddhaghosa's Kaṅkhāvitaraṇī, boundaries (sīmā), and the Sīmākathā of the Samantapāsādikā.
- [Banerjee 1979] Anukul Chandra Banerjee, Sarvāstivāda Literature (1979) — Placement of the Uposathakkhandhaka within the Pali Mahāvagga.
- [Kang-yuan Sung 1999] Kang-yuan Sung, Tradition and Development in the Mo-ho-seng-ch'i-lu (1999) — Note on the alternative designation 'uposathasamyutta' in the Sattasatikakkhandhaka.
